provenance.notes: Captured from saved classifier run 29626 (review 18998, model openai/gpt-6-luna, 2026-10-28T08:29:25.366Z). Production rationale: The source describes one bourbon bottle, but its Batch 1 and 59.79% ABV combination conflicts with the available official-page result for 2026 Batch 3. The inspected Rare Character Limited Release candidate is Batch No. 3 from 2025, a distinct release, so it is not a safe match. The conflicting release identity also prevents a supported creation. Checked 2026-11-03. The official RCLR page's 2026 table lists Straight Bourbon Batch 1 119.56 / 59.79% (7-16 years), Batch 2 119.94 / 59.97%, Batch 3 119.80 / 59.90%, and separate rye and straight lines. Production read a search snippet as tying 59.79% to Batch 3. Whisky Advocate's category is Bourbon/Tennessee Whiskey. Existing Rare Character Limited Release Bottles use name 'Limited Release' with edition 'Batch N' and Brand Entity 365784; 68981 (Batch 2, 2026) and 68984 (Batch 3, 2026) were created after this run and are not in its candidates.
